anf_compare.notes: No public-domain English of On Pascha exists (Toura 1941; Daly ACW 54 and Witte's German are copyrighted and were not copied). Sense checked against the locked Witte Greek (and, for 1.94, Victor of Capua's Latin as Witte prints it) and the wording of the cited scriptures.

bible_refs.note: Address to Moses and Aaron, then the tenth-day command to the congregation.

pass_a_gloss: For this is not said by God to all the people but toward Moses and Aaron only. For it is not written: And God said toward the people: This month is for you beginning of months… but it is written: And the Lord said toward Moses and Aaron in the land of Egypt saying… then he adds: Speak toward all congregation of sons of Israel saying: On the tenth of this month let each take a sheep.
pass_b_english: For this is not said by God to all the people, but only to Moses and Aaron. It is not written: "And God said to the people: This month is for you the beginning of months; it is first for you among the months of the year." It is written: "And the Lord said to Moses and Aaron in the land of Egypt, saying: This month is for you the beginning of months; it is first for you among the months of the year." Then he adds: "Speak to all the congregation of the sons of Israel, saying: On the tenth of this month let each take a sheep."
source_text: Οὐ γὰρ πα[ντ]ὶ τῷ λαῷ τοῦτο ὑπὸ τοῦ [θ(εο)ῦ λ]έγεται, ἀλλὰ πρὸς μόν[ους] Μωϋσῆν καὶ Ἀαρών· [οὐ γ]ὰρ γέγραπται· "Καὶ εἶπε[ν ὁ] θ(εὸ)ς πρὸς τὸν λαόν· Ὁ μὴν οὗ[τ]ος ὑμῖν ἀρχὴ μηνῶν, πρῶ[τ]ος ὑμῖν ἐστιν ἐν τοῖς μ[ησὶ]ν τοῦ ἐνιαυτοῦ", ἀλλὰ γέγρ[απτ]αι· "Εἶπεν δὲ Κ(ύριο)ς πρ[ὸς Μ]ω[ϋσ]ῆν καὶ Ἀαρὼν [ἐν γ]ῇ [Αἰγύ]πτῳ [λ]έγω[ν· Ὁ μὴν οὗτο]ς ὑμῖν ἀρχὴ [μηνῶν, πρ]ῶτός ἐστιν ὑμῖ[ν ἐν τοῖς μησὶν] τοῦ ἐνιαυ[τοῦ", τότε δ’ἐπιφ]έρει· "[Λάλησον πρὸς πᾶσαν συ]ναγω[γὴν υἱῶν Ἰ(σρα)ὴλ λέγων· Τῇ δεκά]τῃ τ[οῦ μηνὸς] τούτο[υ λ]α[βέτ]ω[σ]α[ν ἕκαστος] πρόβατον".
